**Figured out how to get an MCP into Siri (kind of)**

Basically, I wrote an MCP tool to connect to my Fitness Pal thing which is kinda nice and all and it works via MCP (though it has a bit of problems, it does work).

I hosted the MCP on my own server, added OAuth cause why not but then that made a problem for me cause the main intention was to make calorie tracking seamless which the OAuth MCP would not allow and the Siri AI does not at the time of writing this have a direct MCP integration, or even via Shortcuts and nor does Shortcuts support OAuth *YET* so a nifty workaround was to use Ask Claude short cut, ensure the Claude connector works before hand which I will make my own blog on down the line, and basically Ask Siri to Ask Claude to Ask my MCP to log it to MCP (whew). It works. Does it make sense? Not really but it was fun.

![Photo, 11 Nov 2026](https://anshumankmr.github.io/media/8eef4c155a80-photo-2026-11-11.png)
